初次使用纸桥 1.8，请先到“设置 > 共享记录”查看一条申请的状态。项目成员提交资料共享申请，由审核员批准。项目负责人可在这里查看已批准和被拒绝的申请；打开记录不代表负责人批准申请。

连接中断时，纸桥会暂停上传，草稿未说明是否还有其他暂停原因。审核员批准前，成员可以撤回申请；批准后，若共享已经开始，撤回可能失败。

体验版记录保留 7 天，包括被拒绝的申请，但这不表示资料文件会在 7 天后自动删除。一次最多上传 8 个文件，其中任意一个失败，都不会撤销其他已完成的文件。

In FernDesk 3.1, start in Settings > Sharing and open Audit history. As a workspace owner, you can see document-sharing requests submitted by contributors and accepted by reviewers. Viewing the log does not mean you accept a request.

If the malware scan finds a suspicious attachment, FernDesk pauses that upload. The source does not specify whether other events can pause uploads. Contributors can withdraw requests until a reviewer accepts them. After acceptance, withdrawal may fail while sharing is already in progress.

On the Starter plan, Audit history retains entries for 14 days, including rejected requests. This does not mean the documents themselves are deleted after 14 days.

我更在意能查清一次失败，而不是把“永不丢失”写在首页。回执盒采用“至少一次投递”：同一条通知可能重复到达。接收应用需保存 event_id 24 小时，期间忽略相同 event_id 的重复通知。

服务只在收到非 2xx 响应时重试，最多 3 次，全部在 10 分钟内发生。2xx 仅表示接收应用已接受投递，不表示业务处理成功。重试通知可能乱序到达。

管理员在通知失败重试记录查询页只能查看已发生的重试，不能预测下次是否成功。先到“帮助 > 通知示例”发送一次测试，再用相同 event_id 测试重复通知。

My calendar is a stubborn little gatekeeper. I use QuietSlot to protect one writing hour each morning because meetings kept landing there. With read-only calendar sync, QuietSlot reads busy times but cannot create, move, or delete events. When two calendars disagree, it treats either busy signal as busy. A free slot appears only when both calendars are free.

The free plan connects two calendars. A sync can take up to five minutes, and the screen shows when it last finished. Start by connecting one calendar and checking that its busy times match.

I prefer an honest retry contract to a claim of perfect delivery. ParcelPing provides at-least-once delivery, meaning the same webhook event may arrive more than once. There is no setting for how long your app retains idempotency keys, the identifiers used to recognize duplicates. Your app must store each event_id for 24 hours and ignore deliveries with the same event_id during that period.

If your app returns a non-2xx response, ParcelPing retries up to three times within 10 minutes. A 2xx response marks that delivery accepted; it does not prove your app finished processing. Retried events can arrive out of order. ParcelPing does not provide exactly-once delivery.

Start with the example at /docs/webhooks and test a duplicate event before going live.

From 12 November 2026, AtlasBox 2.4 enables background export for paid workspaces created after 1 June 2026, only when an owner turns on Background export. Existing workspaces remain on manual export. Free workspaces receive no automatic rollout.

The export approval history shows export requests submitted by editors and approved by owners. It excludes rejected requests.

In an internal test of 40 files, each under 10 MB, median export time fell from 18 seconds to 12 seconds. This is not a promise about other file sizes or accounts. Exports may take longer while the service is busy.

Cancellation stops files that have not started exporting. A file already in progress may finish. Details are in Help > Export.

I built QueueNote because chasing approvals ate my Fridays. To set when clients receive approval reminders, open Settings > Reminders. As a planner, you can choose 09:00-17:00 in your own time zone.

Client reminders exclude weekends only if you enable Skip weekends, which is off by default. QueueNote sends nothing until you press Publish. Preview shows the next three planned delivery times, so choose a window, inspect Preview, then press Publish.

If you edit the window after publishing, the change affects future reminders, not messages already queued. QueueNote cannot tell whether a client has read a reminder.
